cohort: 101,259 women with chronic hypertension who had term, singleton, vertex births
finding: Women with chronic hypertension who gained ≥20 lb above National Academy of Medicine guidelines had increased odds of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, while those who gained less than the guidelines had increased odds of small-for-gestational-age neonates.
mod_finding: Excess gestational weight gain in women with chronic hypertension was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
